scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.test:regression: npm run build && npm run test:regression:prepare && playwright test -c playwright.regression.config.js
scripts.test:regression:smoke: npm run build && npm run test:regression:prepare && playwright test -c playwright.regression.config.js --grep @smoke
scripts.test:regression:bug: npm run build && npm run test:regression:prepare && playwright test -c playwright.regression.config.js --grep @bug
scripts.build:backend: npm run prepare:jpype && node scripts/backend-python.cjs backend/scripts/build_backend.py
scripts.build:unpack: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --dir && npm run test:package:contents
scripts.build:win:installer: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never && npm run test:package:contents
scripts.build:win:zip: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --win zip && npm run test:package:contents
scripts.build:win:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --win nsis zip --publish never && npm run test:package:contents
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --linux
